policy.dataset_preference: Extend suitable existing datasets, including third-party datasets, before creating new datasets.
policy.upstream_contributions: Assess schema, provenance, licence, coverage and maintainer contribution rules. Prepare scoped contributions for suitable third-party datasets. Do not automatically publish to third-party repositories.
policy.reports: Completed report editions are frozen; refreshes do not change reports.
policy.new_datasets: No automatic creation. Document why extending or contributing to an existing dataset is unsuitable first.

upstream_candidates.fit: Current successor to san-diego-council; assess primary-source document links, coverage and source-ID corrections. Follow upstream build scripts and schema rather than create a competing council dataset.
CC0 statewide county-board tables include San Diego; assess original San Diego reader, grant/agreement identifiers and provenance before proposing changes.
Local ordinance corpus: assess citations, effective dates, amendments and source-link corrections; licence must be verified.
Service-provider directory: assess regional coverage and evidence-backed corrections; verify original source and directory scope.
